findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "board" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "The top of one category's Substack leaderboard, with each writer's followers, paid band and move since the previous board. board is bestsellers (ranked by paid subscribers, the default) or rising (recent paid growth). category is a slug or name such as technology, business, culture or U.S. Politics;" → after: "The top of one category's Substack leaderboard, with each writer's followers, paid band and move since the previous board. The result says when the board was read, matching the date on the category page. board is bestsellers (ranked by paid subscribers, the default) or rising (recent paid growth). c"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
